disclaimer.title: How reviews work
disclaimer.subtitle: Reviews from past guests help our community learn more about each home. By default, reviews are sorted by relevancy. Relevancy is based on recency, length, and information that you provide to us, such as your booking search, your country, and your language preferences. Only the guest who booked the reservation can leave a review, and Airbnb only moderates reviews flagged for not following our policies. To be eligible for a percentile ranking or guest favorite label, listings need at least 5 reviews in the last 4 years. Criteria is subject to change. Learn more in our Help Center

content.htmlText:
Graça is a neighborhood that stretches along the flanks of one of Lisbon's seven hills.
Here you can feel the true Lisbon atmosphere and meet its inhabitants.
Away from the hustle and bustle of the most touristy areas, here you can find tranquility in a popular neighborhood, whose house facades are covered with azulejos.
A few minutes walk from the center of Lisbon, it’s a quiet residential area with a supermarket, café-bakeries and restaurants nearby.

htmlDescription.htmlText:
Completely renovated apartment in the historic district of Graça, near Santa Apolónia, with a bedroom, wc, equipped kitchen, living room and terrace.

The space
The apartment has a simple, modern, romantic, portuguese inspired decoration.
The kitchen is equipped with a dishwasher, washing machine, microwave, electric kettle and coffee machine.
The apartment has a flat screen TV, free wi-fi and air conditioning.

Kindly note:
To enjoy the beautiful view of the terrace of this apartment, you must go up to the 3rd floor of a typical old building! Since it is located in an old part of the city, there is no elevator! An authentic staircase ... but you will see that it's worth it, oh yes it's worth it... Unique!

Guest access
2 minutes from the bus stop and 15 minutes walk from the train and metro of Santa Apolónia. Also 15 minutes walk from Largo da Graça, where stops the famous tram 28, an itinerant antiquity that runs through the oldest streets of the city.
Near the apartment, you will have the opportunity to visit two fantastic views:
- Miradouro da Graça, around the old church, offers views of the neighborhoods of Mouraria and Alfama and St George's Castle;
- Miradouro do Senhora do Monte, even more spectacular, admires almost all Lisbon to the Tagus.

Other things to note
There is at the moment construction work in front of the house.

Basic items are provided for your arrival, including first day toiletries, toilet paper etc. These items are provided as a courtesy only - replacements or refills are not included.
